author: Kenney
modifications: Directional renders cropped and recolored graphite by tools/prepare-weapons.cjs. Fictional stylized weapons, not branded firearm replicas.
selection: blasterD: stock and rifle magazine; blasterG: broad shotgun barrel and fore-end; blasterE: long precision barrel; blasterJ: heavy revolver frame; blasterN: slim machine pistol. Visually verified against the pack renders.
originalBat: Original wooden bat generated with pngjs by tools/prepare-weapons.cjs; no third-party model or texture. Runtime melee uses matching vector geometry.
runtime: PNG sprites only. GLB source models are retained for offline editing.
weaponAudio: Original procedural PCM WAV effects generated by tools/generate-sfx.js; not firearm recordings.
